column2: Non-accepted pops are pressed to adopt our culture, which raises their consciousness and their militancy.
Our soldiers still go to war with spears and bows. Land defence is 10% weaker, though the people are calmer for it.
Muskets are issued to the army, granting flintlock rifles and advancing civilisation by 1% a year, at the price of dearer research.
Our own workshops turn out muzzle-loaded rifles, advancing civilisation by 1% a year at the price of dearer research. Available from 1840.
Breech-loaded rifles are bought abroad, advancing civilisation by 2% a year at the price of dearer research. Available from 1850.
The latest bolt-action rifles are purchased abroad, advancing civilisation by 3% a year at a steep price in research. Available from 1870.
We field no guns at all. Land defence is 20% weaker, though the people are calmer for it.
Bronze muzzle-loaded guns are cast for the army, advancing civilisation by 2% a year at the price of dearer research.
Iron muzzle-loaded guns and fire control advance civilisation by 2% a year at the price of dearer research. Available from 1840.
Iron breech-loaded guns are bought abroad, advancing civilisation by 3% a year at the price of dearer research. Available from 1860.
Steel breech-loaded guns are purchased abroad, advancing civilisation by 1% a year at a steep price in research. Available from 1880.
Troops are called up as levies when war comes. Mobilisation is a little larger and the people calmer, but no drill of any kind is taught.
Regular field drills add 2% land organisation and a little mobilisation, and advance civilisation by 1% a year at the price of dearer research.
Tactical drill on the European model adds 5% land organisation and advances civilisation by 1% a year. Available from 1840.
Army schools add 5% land organisation and give recruits 5 experience, advancing civilisation by 2% a year. Available from 1850.
A standing professional army adds 10% land organisation and 10 starting experience, advancing civilisation by 3% a year. Available from 1880.
Commissions go to the nobility. Consciousness falls by 2%, but the army gains no professional leadership at all.
Foreign officers command our regiments, adding 25% leadership and advancing civilisation by 1% a year at the price of dearer research.
Our own officers are trained abroad, adding 50% leadership and advancing civilisation by 1% a year. Available from 1850.
Officer schools of our own add 75% leadership and advance civilisation by 2% a year. Available from 1870.
A professional officer corps doubles our leadership and advances civilisation by 3% a year. Available from 1880.
In the settlement of a great war, sweep away the enemy government and impose a revolutionary regime of our own ideology.
Overthrow the enemy government and install a regime of our own ideology.
Bring our allies into this war on our side.
The doctrine of mechanised warfare, worked out in the decades after the Great War.
Quick-firing guns with hydraulic recoil, laid on targets the gunners cannot see.
Central banking and modern credit markets on the twentieth-century model.
The modernist movement in art, architecture and letters.
Generation and distribution of electric power on a national scale.
The carrier and the submarine displace the line of battle.
Firepower doctrine drills the line to win the firefight: army units gain attack and need less supply, while artillery loses most of its attack.
High-pressure steam and Portland cement let our heavy industry produce more and waste less.
Advances in medicine and comfort create a wide market for luxury manufactures.
Inorganic chemistry improves the smelting of steel, raising heavy industry output and throughput.
Electric furnaces produce steel of consistent quality, raising heavy industry output and throughput.
Demand that $RECIPIENT$ secede territory to form a colonial concession.
Demand that $RECIPIENT$ submit to a revolutionary government of our own ideology.
Demand that $RECIPIENT$ accept a government of our own ideology.
Call our allies into the war against $RECIPIENT$.
